description: In which order and with which names and Types do dynamic crosstab headings come over PV when the pivot is: pl (1, 2, 9, 10, 100, -5), CStr(pl), pl & '', pc (with Null), pb (with Null), p, g2 (with Null), -pl, pl * 0.5 and Format(pl, '000')? Row headings include a Null group. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
